decisions.reason: As a newly launched automation add-on closely aligned with the firm's established machining and digitalization strategy, it is likely to be retained while the firm scales adoption.

This dual-table loading system builds directly on the existing portfolio and fits the firm's expansion in productivity-enhancing automation, so management would normally give it more time in the market.

Although it is somewhat farther from the core offer, the dedicated presentation and Red Dot award suggest strategic commitment and positive market signaling, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
